fields.label: Application Code
fields.description: Permanent lowercase identifier used by installed applications.

fields.description: Publish the installation page and manifest when you save. Clear to withdraw the entry.

fields.label: Display Order
fields.description: Lower numbers appear earlier in the installation portal. Applications with the same order are sorted by code.

fields.label: Version
fields.description: Version shown in the manifest and the administration preview.

fields.label: Installed App
fields.description: Frappe package name for the application that owns the entry route.

fields.description: Use a short label that can fit under the device home-screen icon.

fields.description: This text appears publicly on the installation portal.

fields.description: Background color supplied to browsers at launch.
